solo_route.how: 1) Write one Hebrew sentence in the same frame: 'when your child ___, but you were ___, so you want ___. But you ___.' and one calm one-line response. 2) In Canva or CapCut, use a static image as the background (a LumeBook hero-child illustration showing a big feeling, or an AI-generated close-up animal or child-sized-emotion image) with the text on a semi-transparent band in the upper third, held for 7-8 s. 3) Add the reassurance line as your own voiceover or a Hebrew AI voice (say it is synthetic if asked), or as a second text card. Do not use a real public figure's face or voice, or a lookalike. 4) Put a keyword CTA in the caption and set up an auto-DM for a free PDF of phrases.
solo_route.needs: A barter child psychologist or emotion-coaching expert to vet the wording and the 'phrases not to say' list, and a DM automation tool for the keyword.
